questions.question: Under the 'Your cancellation rights' section of the Distinct Motor policy, how many days does the policyholder have the statutory right to cancel, and what refund entitlement applies if the insurance cover has not yet commenced? Additionally, if the insurance cover has already commenced, what refund will the policyholder receive?
questions.reference: You have a statutory right to cancel your policy within 14 days from the day of purchase or renewal of the contract, or the day on which you receive the policy or renewal documentation, whichever is the later. If you wish to cancel and the insurance cover has not yet commenced, you will be entitled to a full refund of the premium paid. Alternatively, if you wish to cancel and the insurance cover has already commenced, you will be entitled to a refund of the premium paid, less a proportionate deduction for the time we have provided cover.
